# percent-nlu

> percent-nlu is a tiny open-source (MIT) language model — 1.16M parameters, 1.2 MB — that understands
> percentage questions written in natural language in English, Portuguese and Spanish and returns the right calculator
> tool call with each number in its role. It runs entirely in the browser (dependency-free JavaScript) or in Python,
> in about a millisecond, with no server or API key.

Use it to add natural-language input to a percentage calculator, a spreadsheet, a chatbot or a voice assistant.

- Tools: percent_of (X% of Y), what_percent (X is what % of Y), percent_increase, percent_decrease (% change from A to B),
  apply_increase (Y plus X%), apply_decrease (Y minus X%); also detects missing numbers ("incomplete") and
  non-percentage questions ("out_of_scope").
- Install: `npm install percent-nlu` (JavaScript) or `pip install "percent-nlu @ git+https://github.com/EmanoelV/percent-nlu#subdirectory=python"` (Python).
- Accuracy on hand-checked gold sets: 90–98% exact (tool + every argument) across English, Spanish and Portuguese; the confidence gate answers ~80–95% of questions at ~96–100% precision.
